note: This file is a MMDetection3D configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts, lists, scalars). No functions, classes, or callable APIs are defined. It configures a CenterPoint 0.2-pillar SECOND SecFPN model for 10-class 3D object detection on the nuScenes dataset using a cyclic 20-epoch schedule with 4 GPUs x 8 GPUs.
config_model: configure the CenterPoint 0.2-pillar SECOND SecFPN model for nuScenes 10-class 3D detection
config_train_pipeline: configure the training pipeline with LiDAR point loading, multi-sweep aggregation, and data augmentation
config_test_pipeline: configure the test pipeline with MultiScaleFlipAug3D for inference on nuScenes point clouds
config_db_sampler: configure the database sampler for hard example mining across 10 object classes
config_data_loading: configure NuScenesDataset data loading with CBGSDataset wrapper and LiDAR box type
